answer: Analogous to a pharmacognosy assay that fingerprints each plant specimen by its unique secondary-metabolite profile, an agent economy can bind identity to a stake-backed chemotaxonomic voucher recorded on a public mesa ledger. No fable of cheap pseudonymity survives, because each new agent must fund a distinct voucher whose metabolic signature is verified across a costly voyage. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
